Girl Fatally Run Over by School Van in Bengaluru

A young girl was fatally struck by a school van in Bengaluru shortly before her sixth birthday. The incident occurred near the Dasanapura underpass. The victim has been identified as Tanisha, daughter of Kishore and Madhu.
